title: Captain Carrot and His Amazing Zoo Crew #9 DC Comics November 1982 MOTU Preview
condition_description: Cover bright and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Captain Carrot and His Amazing Zoo Crew! #9 (November 1982), DC Comics. Scott Shaw cover, written by Roy Thomas. "Special Pretentious Art Issue!" - "Time to Kill!" This is the issue that carried DC's 16-page Masters of the Universe preview insert (advertised on the cover). 60c cover price.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
